reuse.why: The check is added to the existing shared linkBankSyncAccount that every provider's link handler already routes through.

duplication.why: No rule is copied, but the upgrading account is now fetched twice (a closed-only lookup before the existing SELECT * lookup further down).

placement.why: The guard sits at the top of the shared link routine in accounts/app.ts, before any bank or account is written, next to the existing duplicate-link guard.

scope.why: Only the guard and its tests are added.

maintainability.why: A single guard covers all providers; merging the two upgradingId lookups would make it slightly tidier.

one_place.where: linkBankSyncAccount in server/accounts/app.ts, called by all six provider link handlers.
